_why: Row 2890: `h_mad_mutation_harness.py <spec> --append-row <row.json>` inserts one row without reformatting the spec, and refuses a malformed row, a taken name, an anchor that does not match exactly once, or a test id that does not collect. Each mutant drops one refusal, the structural verify, string-aware bracket scanning, or the spec's own layout.

mutations.name: append-accepts-a-taken-name
mutations._mechanism: A second row with an existing name is appended, so two rows share one name.
mutations.find: if any(m.get("name") == row["name"] for m in spec["mutations"]):  # M:APPEND-DUP

mutations.name: append-accepts-an-absent-anchor
mutations._mechanism: An anchor that matches nowhere is appended; the row could never mutate anything.

mutations.name: append-accepts-a-malformed-row
mutations._mechanism: A row without `replace` is appended and breaks the spec at load time.
mutations.replace: if not (True or isinstance(row, dict)  # M:APPEND-ROW-SHAPE

mutations.name: append-skips-the-structural-verify
mutations._mechanism: An insert at the wrong bracket is written, changing a key nobody asked to change.

mutations.name: append-scanner-ignores-escaped-quotes
mutations._mechanism: A `\"` inside a string ends it early, so the scan finds the wrong bracket on specs whose anchors quote code.

mutations.name: append-always-renders-multi-line
mutations._mechanism: A spec whose rows are one line each gets a multi-line row, a layout change in review.

mutations.name: append-escapes-non-ascii-in-a-literal-spec
mutations._mechanism: A spec that writes non-ASCII literally gets `\u` escapes in the new row.
mutations.find: ascii_only = all(ord(c) < 128 for c in text)

mutations.name: append-skips-the-collect-check
mutations._mechanism: A row naming a test id that does not exist is appended, so its kill is unattributable.
mutations.find: if collected.returncode != 0 or not _collected(row["test"], collected.stdout, root):  # M:APPEND-COLLECT

mutations.name: append-ignores-a-rootdir-relative-id
mutations._mechanism: pytest prints ids relative to the rootdir above the spec root; without the prefix match every real id in this repository is refused.
